notes.title: Patch 1.1 Sneak Peek: Shiny Morps, Artifacts, and More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/818c47ec12bdcf0bf5f27ab99c9723f19f323c24.png

Hello, Interns!
We're getting closer to the release of our first major update since launch. In patch 1.1, we will introduce some fun new features and improvements: you'll finally get to see Shiny Morps in action, dress them up with hats, and enjoy full controller support for a smoother gameplay experience. Keep reading for a sneak peek at what we’re working on right now!

Shinies & Morp-Hats!
We're not just giving you more ways to customize your Morps, but we're also adding more variety to Morps themselves! Pop a hat on your favorite regular Morp, or go all out and dress up a Shiny version to really show off. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a6bfc8836f022e68f9ee4a55f5d41d035ed4114.png
The Archive & Artifacts! 
This new mechanic adds a fun side activity for collectors and for players who love keeping a stash of resources, just in case. The Archive is closely tied to Artifacts, which we're also adding to the game. Players will be able to find Artifacts all over the world while performing various activities, then turn them in at the Archive for some cool rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d941e282b6a576c1ba1ddc189e1de0bc7f649d31.png
New Player Skins!
You’ll have the chance to personalize your character even more. Whether you want to create a unique look, new skins will help you truly associate yourself with your in-game persona. It's all about making your character stand out and reflect your style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/357b5e5af564acc95128e23b57e92e0626c4b9fc.png
More Decor!
It’s going to be easier than ever to make your world feel even more cozy and personal with all new additions of decor. Don’t be shy, let your creativity run wild and build some awesome creations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/307ce9303701c1ecf6a2cbc1d3f0642d0db25d43.png
Controller Support!
The controller support rework is almost complete! With patch 1.1, it’ll be fully integrated into the game, offering a much more immersive experience for controller lovers.

And More!
Balance tweaks, error fixes, other improvements, and more changes for a better gameplay experience!

Discount!
We are celebrating our participation in Creature Collector Fest with a cheeky discount, so don't miss your chance to try out Time to Morp if you’ve always wanted to!

notes.title: Time to Morp is Officially Launching Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/e6ede353631e2a262ae2689bbba15ff25542e4a5.png

Hello, Interns!
We’re so excited to announce that Time to Morp is finally out of Early Access and ready for you to try, with all the awesome changes we made based on community feedback! If you're new to Time to Morp, dive into Morphing with a 30% launch discount!

[previewyoutube=Oq1r6GyGMNI;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve completely changed the whole game, and because of that, save files created before March 6th won’t work. But don’t worry — a totally fresh experience is ready for you and your friends, with changes including:

What's New?

Fishing
Catch fish and seaweed — unique ingredients for cooking. Want to fish more efficiently? Simply upgrade your fishing rod for better results! And hey, you might even get lucky and reel in bags of goodies filled with useful resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/2e9ad78c3df70994d54df046d43959c378f4e035.gif

Cooking
We’ve added tons of new recipes, including snacks for Morps! Rare ingredients will level up your dishes, and you can give them to Morps or NPCs to boost your reputation for juicy rewards! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3d0cedc8e3418219283c61bbfb578ba99ebc3f59.gif

Personal Housing
As you level up your city, you'll eventually unlock a personal home! With all the themed decor, you can make it cozy right away. You’ll be able to build a small or big house not just for yourself, but for each of your friends too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/f2de01978aa0ff4fcdc305eb4f8043ca06f9e264.gif

Shopping
Each NPC now has their own shop. They can sell you themed decor, rare recipes, cool abilities, or just some regular resources if you're running low!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b84d90f5ec3df1223f88cb317733d83b8426a0db.gif

City Center
You can build, rank up your City Center and earn rewards! As you continue to build your city, you'll unlock even more unique decor to make it your own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/920745c51b4d74da4120a8228c293e9000a09b7b.png

Tools and Terraforming
Pickaxe, axe, shovel, and other new tools let you terraform the landscape however you want! Dig with the shovel, clear stones with the pickaxe, and cut down vegetation with shears. Don't forget that you can always boost your efficiency with upgraded tools — just level up your reputation with NPCs to earn upgrades as rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8b6a5baad6b33ffcc729a8671f86a9cf1ff449e8.gif

Researcher
There’s more fun tech to explore in Researcher, from water tech to lasers and generators — all designed to help automate your production!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/5bb5a27241eaa1693b09dd22aa6139deb5b8c892.gif

Exploration
Explore and complete different world events for rewards, uncover mysteries of abandoned huts, and collect rare resources!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/72bb1787dea81bf728e08797e731d45763bc8a44.png

Cozy Feeling 
We’ve not only changed the mechanics of Time to Morp, but also revamped the overall look with new style, colors, visuals, and more, all to create a more relaxing gameplay experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d64e0d49db17117f024a4d31378d6e3888b5d7a3.png

...and more!
There are also tons of small fixes and improvements we've made, but if we listed them all, it would probably take 15 pages, check them out for yourself by trying out Time to Morp now together with your friends!

What's Next?
We're not done improving Time to Morp and already have plans for patch 1.1. See for yourself what else we have in store!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/60fcf2a8910fafeda432aeea22bec688a53dc483.png

Yogscast is live, streaming Time to Morp on  YouTube and  Twitch to celebrate game's full release. Come join the fun and be part of excitement!

notes.title: Cozy Decor and Personal Home Coming March 6th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/18467a492f411a17396a39c11db119b756dfa3a2.png

Hello, Interns!
We’ve got few last things to share before Time to Morp officially leaves Early Access! From new ways to collect lucky coins to cozier looks and a whole bunch of decor options, there’s a lot to look forward to. Let’s take a look at the exciting new features coming your way on March 6th with the full release!

How to get lucky coins?
Decor will be unlockable using lucky coins, which players can collect while exploring and leveling up reputation with Morps! But you can also automate the process — just set up a Luck Extractor, and you'll earn coins in exchange for resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a09136cb110493250c56fc23af6b644abd37eb2.gif

Themed Decor
Decor will be also available in NPC shops, with each NPC selling their own themed decor. For example, the Gardener will offer wheelbarrows, shovels, and buckets, while the Mechanic will have wrenches, cars, tires, and more! NPC shops won’t just have decor — they’ll also offer cool abilities, recipes, gadgets, and resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/040d915a202059065b13497be0cf57475d26fbf1.png

Personal Home
As you level up your city, you'll unlock more and more home-themed decor — beds, chairs, tables and more — until you eventually unlock a personal home! And with all the themed decor, you can make it cozy right away. You’ll be able to build a small or big house not just for yourself, but for each of your friends too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/47735c63bce811a5c8f47388c753793da743d3b0.png

Cozier Look
We're tweaking the overall vibe of all models in the game to be less sci-fi and have cozier look instead, making them a better fit for the game's theme! We will continue to improve them if needed. 

City Defining Decor
You’ll be able to develop your city with a cozier look too, not just your personal home! There will be more road signs, new bridges, notice board, and decor that can turn into local attractions, like fountains and gazebos!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ced9d991f4babd0fcad855bdd8ecacd653ac1717.png

New Fences
Fences are getting a visual upgrade too. Their look will change depending on the area they’re set to, like Forest, Tech, Laser, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ba2204cebd1cdf7511f619a2e0bd02ce367307b4.png

Food
There will be lots more delicious food for you to cook — we made sure it looks just as tasty as it sounds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6f31dc2a4fce3fb15e8503928e233e7e17b4dc3a.png

Names
As a little extra touch of magic, we're finally giving proper names to all NPCs and Morps, making every interaction feel more personal!

Small Patch - Live Now!
We also made a few changes to the game, including:

Improved sky color: this is the first step in reworking colors for Time to Morp! We'd love to hear what you think so we can keep improving the game's colors together, step by step.
Removed festive hats from Morps — but don’t worry! They’ll be back along with a bunch of other hats we’re planning for patch 1.1!
Added a disclaimer about save files: just a quick reminder — because of all the changes we’ve made, current save files won’t work after release of patch 1.0. But don’t worry, plenty of fresh experiences await!

The Archive

Don’t forget to show off your rarest finds on a pedestals (newly added items) and flaunt your achievements. We'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available shortly after!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50c42537dc3567db5061ce7bcd02e9d540515c74.png

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/910fe3e1d9176ded341deab9843a1332f830e3e8.png

Hello, Interns!
Another blog post with updates on our work with Time to Morp is here! Today's topic covers a lot of changes related to miscellaneous activities in the game. We'll be talking about updates of Researcher and Extractor, improvements of terraforming mechanic, a new City Hub, and more changes related to multiple UIs and their functionality. And as a bonus, we’ll tell you about our special Holiday patch that will for sure boost your Holiday spirit! Sounds exciting, right? Let’s dive into all the details!

Tech Over Questing
We're making sure to create a smooth learning curve, which is why all the basic tech you'll need at the start of the game will be unlocked as you play  to remove overall complexity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/64e10747bea2d5e44e571716c84b3ec6552bd714.gif

Unrecognizable Researcher
We’re merging researches like Water Tech and Sprinklers into a single unlock, so (for example) all water automation tech becomes available at once. This reduces the number of unlockables in the Researcher, making the interface cleaner and easier to navigate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50f337f9cf02786bfd56f315d33a91a00d20bc8c.png

New: The Lab
Gameplay will now focus more on The Lab (formerly Extractor). Before, The Lab offered optional rewards that could be easily skipped. Now, we’re making prices clearer and rewards more valuable, like inventory upgrades (moved from Researcher). You’ll also be able to use The Lab outside area, giving you the option to fully automate it or manually fill it from your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b6a041e55e288f1fa3043d1510ac0a4c089d896c.gif

Improved Terraforming
Terraforming will be FREE! Smart targeting will also be easier, with a focus on Minecraft-like simplicity in digging. You’ll be able to terraform using new tools: a shovel for digging, a pickaxe for removing stones, an axe for trees, and shears for bushes. These will all be available early in the game, along with the Uprooter Gadget (for moving trees). The speed of tools and area of effect will be also upgradable by leveling up your NPC reputation. In addition to all, terraforming will occasionally drop rare resources!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/245a283fd50c365ab227223f161a80d0b41ec5ea.gif

New: City Hub
City Hub is a new entity you can build and level up by completing specific requirements! You’ll get more decor as rewards for leveling up the City’s Rank (or through NPC shops and world finds) instead of in the Researcher. As you level up, City's Hub model will also update. In the future, you’ll be able to name your City Hub once it hits certain rank. Leveling up will also unlock more city-specific decor, like a big fountain, park, mill, and more! We’re also moving optional quests, like "Build 20 roads," to the City Hub to keep things organized and less overwhelming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ac9c201916dc98492db3559e913cb8610ca867b8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/03aacec547ec2b090f1f8c055862420e0b4a7002.gif

And There are More Changes!
More changes we are working on include:

Standardized UI: all tech in game will have a consistent UI and functionality to avoid confusing players with multiple UIs across different tech. 
Like The Lab, all tech will be fully automatable, with the option to use everything manually as well.
Chests: power won't be required. In the future, we plan to add filters for Chests (will work similar to Bowls), allowing players to specify exactly which resources they want Chests to pick up.
Cutscenes: almost all cutscenes (except the main ones) will be skippable! Plus, in co-op, you'll be able to watch most cutscenes alone without distracting your friends!

Holidays Special: Live Now!
If you update your game, adorable Morps with festive hats will be waiting for you to visit them!

New UI
The biggest feedback we’ve gotten so far is about the inconvenience of the UI in Time to Morp. The current UI has been around since the beginning, and while the game’s mechanics and other elements have changed a lot, we didn’t update the UI to keep up with those changes. So now, we’re completely reworking it to better fit the game’s new mechanics and improvements

notes.title: Dev Diaries: Map Gen
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/e6504db1c929b73cd68b18794bbaf5c0253ca7d1.png

Patch 0.14 in April
Hey, Interns, it's been a while! That's why we thought we'd chat a bit more about what's coming for the next patch (which will be available by the end of April), why we're tossing in those changes, and what's on the horizon after that. Today's focus: "Maps" and all things related. Let's dive in!

The World
Exploration is a key part of the game! Whether you're sprinting around just for giggles or dash between bases, it should be a blast, with activities along the way and fresh scenery around every bend. That's why in the upcoming patch, we're doubling down on all fronts, aiming to spice up the map with more variety and interactions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c5390394d80c3c36b3db00ca9791b496538c9082.gif

Biomes
In the current patch (0.13), all three biomes have the same grass patterns and cliffs, making the map kinda blend together and doesn't really add anything fresh for exploration. So, in the upcoming patch (0.14), we're improving biomes by giving each of them its own unique style plus we are adding bunch of new models to keep things exciting and different!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/676f23e8c2ad4c0cb4a961bd7e3be1773b9701ae.png

New Lakes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/79a189949645c97793424b827281ca5b83161c1b.png

More cacti to really nail vibes of desert!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/b243842452efbc889d24beb423838dff229c931f.png

Get ready to stumble upon some new rocks and mountains, dive into pristine lakes, and find new shiny power crystals to build around! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/ce06fa7c582dd9bd2bc5f5f4465b7e74817521ed.png

We're also throwing in some new Tech that you can build only in specific biomes, that would result in intriguing decisions on where to expand your base!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3aea82d3c5249cdd472c30a51b437c196e353998.gif

These tweaks are coming with patch 0.14, promising a whole new vibe and gameplay experience in each biome. But we're not stopping there! We're committed to keep every spot in the game feeling distinct and captivating!

Map Events
As you run from one spot to another, you might stumble upon a flower to pluck, an Alty Morp to catch, or a rare resource to collect. But it still feels like there's not quite enough action during your exploration. That's why for patch 0.14, we're preparing a fresh mechanic — Map Events! Or Side Activities? Or Mini Games...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/0c57260801e8721285e72677999fde279534e967.gif

Map Events will pop up randomly while you're out exploring, throwing puzzles, resource-fetching, or platforming challenges your way! Once you've nailed the mini-game, you'll get sweet resources as a reward. This should entertain Interns on their long adventures between bases with some extra gameplay!

Behind the Scenes
Here's a little secret: the maps are actually hand-drawn and then pieced together to one big map. This lets us craft unique locations, lakes, cliffs, and puzzles, while also ensuring a fresh experience each time you play. We mix and rotate all of the parts to create something totally new and exciting for each playthrough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6cb167e25aa96bdc8ccbbd0fd541479a6bac8bcf.png

We've got specific tools for Map Editing, and if anyone's keen on giving map-making a shot, just let us know! We can streamline the tools, package them up nicely, and add them into the game. You'll be able to create new maps for your friends or community to try out. Picture this: a map dotted with islands, or a sprawling stretch of land where you can only build in one direction... you know what? That's a pretty solid idea. We might just whip up a few for ourselves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8f2b6c76de3936d10919f6c14e091c95f79157f0.gif

Coming Soon
We'll keep working on enhancing the map experience, and here are a few upcoming changes you can expect after patch 0.14:

Cliffs have always seemed a bit empty, so let's spruce them up with some decorations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/472a78890ef956a41ac9e1925b1677f5f50aa071.png

Or how about adding a new landmarks?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/adae71691a5b7e5c88232956cd83d39be6af957a.png

How about some fishing, waterfalls, customizable map sizes, or even some environmental puzzles to solve? The possibilities for the map improvements are endless, and we're totally open to your ideas too! Let us know what you'd like to see in Time to Morp!

See you in April
These aren't the only changes on the horizon for 0.14: we've got new Morp, new Resources, new Recipes, and so much more! Make sure to swing by when patch goes live and give us your feedback! We can't wait to see you in the game! That's all for now. 

Morp like you mean it!

Idea behind this patch is to simplify the early game, giving simple and understandable tools at first, and then replacing them with more advanced technology later in the game.

New Mechanic: Reputation
(Players can complete Quests to increase reputation with Morps and the Crew to get rewards)

New Mechanic: Housing

New Mechanic: Player Emotes
(Players can now use emotes and even Play with Morps!)
New Mechanic: Bowls
(Simple version to move specific items between Areas without dealing with Conditions)

New Research Tree: +50% more nodes to unlock
(bloat, bloat, BLOAT)
New Decor: around 40 new items to decorate with
(Decor mechanic was simplified, allowing easier access and building)
New NPCs: Meet 3 new Crew members!

Improvements:

New Building: Roads (increases Player movement speed)
New Quests (to teach new mechanics)
New Building: Well (fast and easy access to water)
Some Morps are simplified (to prevent unnecessary morphing)
Updated Map (More verticality)
Updated Plant (more visible, animated)
Updated Ground (better colors, smoother edges, more noticeable levels)
Optimization (how ground and biomes are drawn)
Bug Fixes / UX Improvements

notes.title: Playtest is over! (v0.3)
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who participated in the playtest! We had a blast reading your feedback and had a laugh from the bugs you have found! Time to [strike]Morp[/strike] fix some stuff!

Results

Overall, everything went according to plan. Only a few bugs, not too many annoyances, and many requests and suggestions are about something we are already working on! But the best part is that everyone seems to enjoy the gameplay, which makes us quite happy! We just need to keep on working and adding more content!

What's next

Patch 0.4 is already in production, and this time we would like to touch up some existing mechanics (décor, movement) and fully invest in new ones to improve exploration. It would also be cool to finally add some story, so let’s hope we will have time for that! The next playtest is currently planned at the end of the Summer. So be ready to come back and enjoy the game again!

Current version of the game is v0.3, meaning that nothing is final and there is little content to play with. So expect missing mechanics, some imbalance, absence of key rebindings and lack of cool animations on every click, but you should be able to get the feeling of the game and have fun for a couple of hours!

Where to send feedback?
Start a discussion here on Steam, or join our Discord Server to discuss your experience directly with us in #playtest channel. We will be waiting!

For how long the Playtest will last?
We will close the playtest on June 3rd to go through your feedback and then shift our focus back to development.
